structure.unit: Provisions Applicable to Probate and Nonprobate Transfers
Creation, Revocation, and Amendment of Power of Appointment

law.catch_line: Exception to presumption of unlimited authority
law.text:
Unless the terms of the instrument creating a power of appointment manifest a contrary intent, the power is nongeneral if:
The power is exercisable only at the powerholder's death; and
The permissible appointees of the power do not include the powerholder's estate, the powerholder's creditors, or the creditors of the powerholder's estate.
